message.content: {"action":"change_interpolation","reason":"The only evaluated configuration that meets the 8-LSB quality target is the LUT linear-interpolation design at phase_bits=16 (area 1584.56). Nearby lower-precision linear LUTs fail quality, and CORDIC alternatives are larger and also fail. Switching interpolation has 2 legal unvisited neighbors and may improve quality/area tradeoff without increasing precision or table depth, both of which currently have no legal unvisited neighbors."}
